newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Pilots unhurt after Swedish jets crash mid-air.
newsitem.headline: Pilots unhurt after Swedish jets crash mid-air.

text.p: Two Swedish air force jets collided on Thursday but the pilots bailed out and parachuted to safety without injury, the Swedish defence ministry said.
"At the moment we don't know exactly what happened but the accident is being investigated," a spokesman said.

The two JA 37 Viggen jets from the F4 Air Force squadron based in Ostersund were taking part in a routine exercise about five km (three miles) east of Ramsele in central Sweden when the collision occurred at 0740 GMT.
In August, a Swedish Air Force AJS 37 Viggen crashed into the Baltic Sea while on exercise near Ornskoldsvik, 565 km (350 miles) north of Stockholm. The pilot was killed.
